newsitem.title: UK: Investment unhurt by Peru hostage crisis-Fujimori.
newsitem.headline: Investment unhurt by Peru hostage crisis-Fujimori.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori said on Sunday the two-month Lima hostage crisis was having no negative effect on investment in his country.
In an interview before a London conference designed to boost investment links between Britain and Latin America, Fujimori said Peru's economy was performing well and growth was sound.
"The hostage problem is not having any consequence for the flow of Japanese investment or (investment) from anywhere," Fujimori said.
Fujimori said his government had successfully reduced the country's current account deficit this year and expected to cut it further.
He also said he expected growth to reach an annual average of five percent in coming years. Growth in 1996 dipped to 2.8 percent from 7.0 percent the previous year.
Despite a depreciation of the Peruvian currency, the sol, Fujimori said he had no intention of changing exchange rate policy.
He also expressed confidence that his privatisation programme would go ahead without obstacles. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7768
